style: 3D cartoon, original design, tax satire, slapstick
subject: ONE plump male hedgehog on hind legs, brown quills, round belly
second_characters: TWO silent magpies in green accountant visors; the second wears a leather pouch
props: dozens of plain white envelopes spiked on his quills, blank, no digits
environment: autumn forest by day: a burrow under a huge oak root, dry leaves, red mushrooms, a low branch above
motion_rule: the camera travels every frame in sharp 0.3-0.8 s moves, each landing on the gag. 0-1.74: dives down with the envelope, then whips round to his front by 0.6. 1.74-5.85: one arc to his right in sharp 0.5 s snaps, oak roots whipping past behind him, ending at his three-quarter front. 5.85-7.25: pulls straight back, oak and burrow opening, he stays half the frame height, the magpies lifting him. 7.25-10: darts close, whips up with his face to the branch. He fills half the frame height, except the three close-up beats where the envelope or his face fills the whole frame.

audio.pacing: no pauses between sentences; first word at 0.30; last word by 5.85; no words after 6.1
audio.pronunciation: KAZH-dyy GOD a-be-SHCHA-yu, shto raz-be-RUS s na-LO-ga-mi. a pa-TOM a-NI raz-bi-RA-yut-sya sa MNOY.
audio.sfx: envelope thwacks, leaf rustle, wing claps, hedgehog huffs

timeline.a: close-up: from the branch the first magpie flicks a spinning envelope; the camera dives with it onto the hedgehog's back, thwack, he hops
jaw working, the hedgehog raises his right paw in an oath, pricks it on his own quill, hops on one foot
jaw working, he yanks the envelope off his back, shakes it below his chin; the second magpie flicks another onto his back, he lurches
close-up: the camera arcs in until his muzzle fills the frame: jaw working, nose twitching; the envelope trembles below his chin
jaw working, both magpies hop onto the oak root on either side of him; he bristles, scuttles back a tiny step
timeline.c: snaps back out to the magpies

timeline.a: jaw working, each magpie bites a spiked envelope on his shoulders; he jabs his chest with the envelope
the magpies flap hard; his feet leave the leaves, paddling in the air; leaves swirl up
by reflex he curls into a ball, dangling between two beaks, still clutching the envelope
close-up: the ball unrolls, the camera darts in until his face fills the frame; he blinks, blows a leaf off his nose
dangling, he holds out the envelope from his paw; the second magpie snatches it, stuffs it in her pouch
the magpies lift him to the low branch; on the way he curls up again
his snout pops out of the ball, puffing, as the magpies set him on the branch like a parcel

negative_prompt: text, digits, subtitles, watermark, zoom, slow push-in, static wide shot, cuts, visible camera equipment, stands in place, closed mouth while speaking, a line said twice, an inserted word, speech after 6.1, foreign accent, feminine word endings, magpies speaking, blood, duplicate hedgehogs, duplicate props, a hedgehog running at the camera on his feet, side tracking pass, belt, rail, trolley
